summary: SAFE-ND staff-only review feature tested end-to-end (backend + browser) against the preview URL. All 10 STEP-5 checklist items PASS. Gate: signed out sees staff-signin-required (no form content, also on /new), API 401; parent sees gate, API 403, no Dashboard card. Staff (professional): Privacy + Professional notices accepted on first sign-in, Dashboard tour skipped, safe-nd-reviews-link opens /staff/safe-nd, '+ Start a new review' shown. New review: Case info, referral, Information Sources checkbox + Other, Communication=Medium, Executive=High + notes, Adult availability Home A/B/Plan -> Save draft -> URL /staff/safe-nd/<uuid>; after reload every value restored (pills checked, navy pill bg). Safety option shows red (rgb 180,35,24) reminder with 'mandatory-reporting' and '911'; unticking hides it. Finalize without signature/date shows the warning, no confirm dialog, stays Draft; after signature+date+Save, Finalize -> confirm accepted -> Final tag, locked note, inputs readonly/checkboxes disabled, Save/Finalize gone, Print / PDF kept; persists after reload. PUT and re-finalize after final -> 409/409. List row: 'TEST_UI Child Alpha | Review date 2026-01-15 · updated ... | Final'. Print media: all 4 .no-print elements display:none, all 7 sections still block. Responsive: scrollWidth == clientWidth at 390x844 (list, new, final) and 1920x800. Backend limits: text/plain 415, >500KB 413, data:'x' 400, invalid JSON 400, unknown id 404, professional DELETE 403. No review contents in supervisor logs. One environment problem found and worked around: the documented SAFE-ND test accounts did not exist (see rca).

minor.issue: After every pytest session, all users with @example.com emails are deleted. That includes the documented SAFE-ND accounts (safend.reviewer.90fd2f@example.com and t_pa_277a90b2@example.com), so they were missing when testing began and logins returned 401. The SAFE-ND reviews and the safe_nd_access records left behind are not cleaned up either.
The content-type check is a substring match ('application/json' in header), so a header like 'text/plain; x=application/json' would get through. Low risk.

issues: The global app footer (data-testid copyright-footer) and any global banners are not marked no-print, so they still appear on the printout/PDF. Minor.
Date fields use the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn calendar. Acceptable because the owner supplied the file verbatim.

action_items: Use a non-@example.com domain for the SAFE-ND test accounts (or exclude them in conftest._purge_fixture_accounts) so they survive pytest runs; update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to match.
Optional: add className='no-print' to the global footer/banners for clean SAFE-ND printouts.
Optional: tighten the content-type check to the media type before ';' == 'application/json'.
critical_code_review_comments: safe_nd.py: the gate, AES-GCM encryption with AAD, the 409 lock that runs before reading the body, the conditional update on status=draft and the admin-only delete are all correct. The access record holds no content.
SafeNdReview.jsx: finalize() checks signature/date on the client, then confirms, then saves if there are unsaved changes, then finalizes. The server checks the saved data again. Correct.
StaffProtected gates on role before rendering, so parents and judges never mount SafeNdReview.

The first staff Dashboard visit shows a tour overlay; click 'Skip tour'. Selectors: get_by_role('radiogroup', name='Communication priority').get_by_text('Medium'), section scopes #sec-referral/#sec-support/#sec-disposition, status text span[aria-live=polite]. rca of the issue: Missing credentials: tests/conftest.py::pytest_sessionfinish -> _purge_fixture_accounts deletes users matching @(example.com|x.com). The SAFE-ND accounts use @example.com, so any pytest run (including the main agent's test_iter121) removes them. Reproduce: run pytest on any test, then log in as safend.reviewer... and get 401 'Invalid email or password'. Fix: use a different domain or add an exclusion list.
